feedbackPlacement.authority: MainViewModel StatusKey, TechnicalError, operation/status origin and busy state; local regions are stateless projections
feedbackPlacement.local: Analyze form and command area, Export Copy/Save area, and History heading/load-retry context
feedbackPlacement.global: Other application contexts and active operations away from their originating page or Analyze mode; shell shares PageHost measure, capped at 1120 epx on large windows
feedbackPlacement.announcementOwner: Only the visible local feedback text is Polite when locally owned; otherwise the existing shell text is Polite. The inactive owner is Off and hidden
feedbackPlacement.lifecycle: Settled navigation clears feedback; busy navigation preserves it. Input edits expire existing validation without revalidating. New commands clear settled feedback and technical detail. Async command origins and a central feedback revision prevent late results replacing a newer command
feedbackPlacement.focus: Feedback updates do not move keyboard focus; validation text is also exposed as input HelpText

screens.primaryQuestion: What should I do now and what did the last analysis show?
screens.emptyState: distinguish zero supported incidents from background-only results; retain any source coverage limits

responsiveRules.small: single content column; intrinsic compact navigation 160–208 epx; brand no wrap, ellipsis only if text scaling exceeds available width; stacked summary counts; 12 epx gutter
responsiveRules.medium: compact summary strip with natural wrapping; 24 epx gutter
responsiveRules.large: constrained 1120 epx content; compact summary strip

screens.primaryQuestion: What kind of analysis matches what happened?

screens.errorState: existing validation/failure text between inputs/source disclosure and primary action; technical details stay subordinate

responsiveRules.large: left-align form content at an 800 epx maximum; use available width below that

responsiveRules.large: three aligned selectors at 920 epx or more available content width; Search spans a stable full row; dense list width remains constrained for scanning
